resources.string: Continue step by step. Status is shown only from real service and device responses.
The current session is verified with the server.
Name and members come from the Backend; this step does not create another family.
Install and open the Child app on the device your family wants to pair. This app does not create a separate child name or profile; the Backend registers it as a device.
On Child, enter the one-time code, review the device name, and confirm family pairing. Share the code only with the intended device.
A short-lived code and QR are created by the Backend after you request them. Android permissions are not requested on this screen.
This list refreshes from the API every 8 seconds to check pairing. Seeing a device does not mean every capability is active.
No new device has appeared from the API yet. Ensure Child confirmed pairing and has network access.
Check last seen and last sync; old data is not live.
Statuses come only from the latest real device snapshot. Location and Usage Access are optional and capability-specific; missing values are never shown as active.
Ordinary Child notifications are not requested. Location/Usage capabilities and background work remain subject to permission and Android restrictions. This screen cannot enable settings remotely.
Setup is not yet fully verified
Basic readiness means only that the device is active and at least one sync is recorded. Check each capability's permission/accuracy separately.
